messages:
Grace O'Connor: kicking off PLG signal pilot outreach today/tomorrow. want to lock: (1) who covers which accounts (2) meeting booking process (3) how we’re logging outcomes for KPI tracking. 

Grace O'Connor: pilot sheet w/ owners is here: https://drive.google.com/.../pilot-account-list-and-owner-mapping (pls check your tab + add notes if you see suppression needed) 

Stephanie Nguyen: thx Grace. for NA, my read is: AEs own any “Dedicated/Private” intent + spend growth signals; SDRs own the rest unless account is already in active opp. correct? 

Isabelle Laurent: yep. ownership rules for pilot: 
- if Company has Open Deal in HubSpot OR “Enterprise - Managed” flag => suppress from SDR sequences; route to AE/CSM task only 
- otherwise: SDR sequence + AE FYI task for high intent (security intent, sustained spend + 429s) 
We’ll keep it manual for pilot but please follow this so attribution isn’t a mess.

Lukas Meyer: EMEA side: I’m covering heliosearch + a couple of EU residency accounts (need to keep messaging tight: region/residency + Dedicated in eu-west). can you confirm who is SDR for EMEA in pilot? 

Grace O'Connor: Rohan will run SDR outreach for EMEA too unless you want AE-led only for specific logos. 

Rohan Mehta: works for me. pls flag any “AE only” accounts in the sheet and I’ll skip sequence enrollment.

Markus Klein: for meeting booking: can we standardize meeting type + calendar link? last pilot I saw random “intro” meetings and no SE prep. 

David Kim: proposal: use HubSpot meeting links with dedicated meeting types: 
- “PLG Signal - Inference Scaling (15m)” (SDR) 
- “PLG Signal - Dedicated/Private Discovery (30m)” (AE) 
Both have required form fields (use case, region, current model, target TPS/latency). I can publish today if everyone agrees.

Stephanie Nguyen: +1. also pls add a checkbox “Triggered by PLG signal” so we can filter. 

Chris Osei: we already created a custom property on Company + a dropdown on Task for pilot tracking. names:
- Company property: `plg_signal_pilot_cohort` (true/false)
- Task property: `plg_signal_disposition` (dropdown)
- Meeting property: `plg_signal_source` (autofill)
David can confirm exact labels in HubSpot UI.

Grace O'Connor: cool. logging outcomes: what are the dispositions we want everyone using? need consistency for KPI dashboard.

Chris Osei: dispositions for pilot (please do NOT free-text): 
1) Connected - meeting booked 
2) Connected - not interested 
3) No response 
4) Bad fit (too small / students / non-prod) 
5) Already working w/ Redwood (existing opp/account team) 
6) Timing (revisit) 
7) Wrong contact / no valid contact
Also add “next step date” if 6.

Isabelle Laurent: and when it’s “meeting booked”: please associate meeting to Company AND (if created) the Deal. we’ve had meetings floating unassociated :grimacing:

Jasmine Liu: CS ask: if you see the account is Enterprise-managed or has a CSM in the record, don’t enroll sequences. tag the CSM in the note. we’re trying to avoid duplicate touch points.

Markus Klein: SE involvement: rule of thumb—if signal includes repeated 429s, sustained spend > threshold, or security intent, loop SE on the meeting invite. I can be backup but prefer Markus (me) + team to be added at booking time so we prep benchmarks.

Stephanie Nguyen: can we be explicit: who is “default SE” per region? 

Markus Klein: for pilot:
- NA: me (Markus) as default; if I’m OOO I’ll reassign in thread 
- EMEA: we’ll use rotating coverage but start with me for first 2 weeks (light volume) 

Lukas Meyer: ok. for EMEA, please also check residency needs before offering Hosted improvements. if they ask “EU-only data” we should steer to Dedicated in eu-west or Private. 

Grace O'Connor: logistics: when SDR books meeting, do we create deal immediately or wait until AE discovery? 

Isabelle Laurent: wait until AE confirms it’s sales-qualified. during pilot, SDR just logs task disposition + books meeting. AE creates deal after discovery if: dedicated/private need OR commit potential within 90 days.

Jordan Blake: +1 to keeping deal creation clean. primary goal of pilot is signal->meeting conversion + quality. we’ll review weekly.

David Kim: FYI on meeting types: I’ll push the two meeting types + required fields in the next hour. once live, pls use ONLY those links for pilot meetings so attribution works.

Rohan Mehta: question: what do I do when I see 2 signals for same company? e.g., pricing page intent + 429s. do we run 2 sequences? 

Chris Osei: no. 1 thread of outreach per company per cool-down. pick highest intent angle (security intent > 429s/perf pain > spend growth > pricing/docs engagement). log the “primary signal” in the task note.

Grace O'Connor: also pls post in this thread if you see duplicates or weird routing. we’re watching for false positives + dedupe issues.

Stephanie Nguyen: can we add a quick template for internal notes on outcome? something like “signal seen / hypothesis / ask”? 

Grace O'Connor: yep, use this in the first task note:
- Signal(s): 
- Why we think it matters: 
- Suggested next step: 
- Suppression check (opp/CSM/opt-out): 

Jasmine Liu: pls include whether there’s an open support ticket. if we’re reaching out on 429s and they’re already in Support queue, we should coordinate.

Markus Klein: +1, and if it’s perf pain: ask for target latency + concurrency + region. don’t assume infra stack (SDR feedback from last thread).

Lukas Meyer: for EMEA messaging, avoid “we saw you hit rate limits” phrasing. maybe “teams at your scale sometimes run into throughput caps; happy to share options.” 

Grace O'Connor: noted. I’ll update the first-touch copy accordingly for EMEA.

David Kim: meeting types are live. links:
- SDR 15m: https://meetings.hubspot.com/.../plg-signal-inference-scaling 
- AE 30m: https://meetings.hubspot.com/.../plg-signal-dedicated-private-discovery

Grace O'Connor: perfect. last item: weekly review. can everyone drop a quick update by EOD Friday in #sales-ops or here? (counts: outreaches, connects, meetings, weird stuff)

Jordan Blake: do it in #sales-ops for visibility + metrics. Grace/Chris will compile. thanks all—let’s keep it tight + respectful; low false positives is the whole game.

Grace O'Connor: :thumbsup: starting outreach now. Rohan I’ll DM you the EMEA subset + any AE-only suppressions once sheet is updated.
